name: @pipeworx/mcp-pitchprotocol

tools.name: pitchprotocol_schema
tools.description: Get the LIVE Pitch Protocol pitch-application schema — the exact fields, character limits, enums, and a complete example a founder (or AI agent) must fill to pitch AI-agent / agent-native startups to matched VC funds via pitchprotocol.vc. Use for "how do I pitch Pitch Protocol", "what does an agent-native VC application require", or before assembling a submission. Returns the authoritative schema (company/sectors/traction/team/raise/governance, submitterType humanFounder|aiAgent|aiFounded). Submission is completed through Pitch Protocol's own email-verified flow.

tools.name: pitchprotocol_application_status
tools.description: Check the status of a Pitch Protocol pitch application by its id (draft | intake | submitted, plus research progress). Read-only — use to track a submission you have already created via Pitch Protocol's flow.

application_id.description: The applicationId returned when the application was created.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-pitchprotocol forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the pitchprotocol pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
